scope_contract.all_official_definition: Bind a complete declared project universe for each distro using its official source/release metadata, preserve every package and upstream workflow/configuration, discover each actual native engine, execute and reconcile all declared cases. A limited ROS core manifest is a separately named subset of the full released repository index.
scope_contract.ecosystem_boundary: The current official rosdistro index is not a claim to enumerate unregistered third-party ROS projects or every external robot repository. Caller must add any further requested official projects with the same explicit lock/inventory.
non_results: Repository metadata rows are not package count or test count.
Remote branch/ref/body observations are not resolved execution checkout/SDK pins.
Existing Unitree commit/tree references are copied from the maintained lock, not invented or freshly qualified Linux inputs.

unitree_projects.scope_findings: README describes catkin build and Gazebo/controller/Rviz launch examples; exact tree has no workflow. Commented catkin test templates are not registered tests.
unitree_projects.environment_requirements: Melodic/Gazebo and locked ROS control dependencies; Kinetic is described as untested upstream. Simulator needs explicit robot/world and observed state/command assertions.

unitree_projects.scope_findings: Foxy and Humble CI workflows only build messages/examples; tagging/release workflows are publishing jobs, not tests. Four selected CMake package roots register ament_lint_auto under BUILD_TESTING.
unitree_projects.environment_requirements: Actual distro-specific Cyclone/RMW/rosidl dependencies and lint dependencies; explicit simulator peer for motor/motion examples. Hardware-network demos are not automatically runnable tests.

unitree_projects.scope_findings: Only observed c-cpp workflow configures/builds CMake; root CMake imports a prebuilt library selected by CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR and builds examples. A build-only CI success is not a functional test result.
unitree_projects.environment_requirements: Actual supplied SDK library and DDS libraries per architecture. Missing architecture library fails; LoongArch/other source ports need real provider rather than relabeling x86/aarch64 prebuilt.

unitree_projects.scope_findings: No selected workflow. test/crc/test_crc.py computes and prints CRC; test/rpc/test_api.py declares constants; client/server and lowlevel files are executable protocol/control examples, not automatically pytest cases.
unitree_projects.environment_requirements: Python>=3.8, actual Cyclone0.10.2/numpy/OpenCV closure. Pair real hello/RPC endpoints in isolated loopback with finite assertions; CRC printed values need independent expected oracle.

unitree_projects.scope_findings: No selected workflow. CMake builds simulator/joystick programs; Python test_unitree_sdk2.py is an endless loopback/domain1 torque publisher. The ROS2 example additionally registers ament lint under BUILD_TESTING.
unitree_projects.environment_requirements: Actual MuJoCo/model assets/SDK2/Python closure and selected rendering/headless provider. A finite witness must assert physics/state/CRC and retire all processes; no generic pytest discovery executes torque demo safely.

unitree_projects.scope: Isaac Lab tasks and DDS simulation
unitree_projects.scope_findings: No selected native workflow/test-directory/build manifest in inspected exact tree metadata. README supplies simulation task/setup/launch guidance, not a JUnit suite.
unitree_projects.environment_requirements: Actual Isaac Sim/Lab/assets/weights/GPU driver and supported hardware proof. An available V100 is not proof of RTX-oriented simulator compatibility; no GPU/robot launch is authorized by this inventory.

unitree_projects.scope_findings: No selected workflow. CMake/example/Python wrapper builds must be distinguished from vendored pybind11 test sources; presence of bundled tests does not mean root build registers them.
unitree_projects.environment_requirements: Actual selected SDK/version/robot pairing, prebuilt native libraries and Boost/toolchain; optional Python wrapper/pybind11 needs its own declared upstream configuration. No blanket robot/model/version interchange.

unitree_projects.scope_findings: No selected workflow. README builds via catkin_make and launches real robot high/low level examples; no selected CMake test registrations observed.
unitree_projects.environment_requirements: Matching legacy SDK release, native ROS1/message generation and actual model. New simulator protocol adapter may validate transport subset; physical movement remains a separate unavailable hardware scope.

unitree_projects.scope_findings: No selected workflow. README uses Gazebo launch plus interactive controller FSM; no selected CMake test registrations observed outside separately owned vendor subtree.
unitree_projects.environment_requirements: Locked Melodic/Gazebo/unitree_ros/unitree_legged_msgs dependencies, explicit finite input/state/physics observer. Keyboard-driven demonstrations need concrete deterministic protocol, not invented pytest tests.

engine_contracts.required_discovery: Actual source-bound CTest --show-only=json-v1; whole configured registered test set, commands, properties, labels and disabled entries.
engine_contracts.required_result: Actual complete execution with output-junit plus raw logs; reconcile registered names, not sum inner framework cases.
engine_contracts.limits: JSON discovery>=3.14; JUnit>=3.21. Historical SDK may lack these. Actual selected test tool compatibility required; no native CTest0=>project alltests PASS.

engine_contracts.required_discovery: Actual source package inventory and generated run_tests targets, all gtest/nosetest/rostest registrations under selected CATKIN_ENABLE_TESTING.
engine_contracts.required_result: Original all-workspace run_tests umbrella plus catkin_test_results and every fresh JUnit under explicit result root.
engine_contracts.limits: run_tests builds tests; plain CTest is not a substitute. ROS1 Python2 nose/rostest/unittest cannot be silently migrated to modern Python/pytest.

engine_contracts.required_discovery: Actual historical stack.xml/manifest.xml, rospack package set, original CMake/rosmake test targets and blacklist/ROS_NOBUILD disposition.
engine_contracts.required_result: Pinned original rosmake test workflow and rosunit/rostest/xUnit reports with explicit selected historical toolchain.
engine_contracts.limits: Five pre-Groovy distributions have no current index-v4 manifest. Historical source/SDK/workflow recovery is required; cannot call these catkin-tested.

engine_contracts.required_discovery: Pinned original ament_tools/ament.py package and test workflow for Ardent, per-package native engines.
engine_contracts.required_result: Original test workflow plus all CTest/nose/JUnit payloads; concrete original SDK required.
engine_contracts.limits: Ardent is not modern-colcon by assumption. Bouncy changed upstream orchestration to colcon.

engine_contracts.required_discovery: Actual whole workspace package discovery, build types, selected/ignored/aborted packages and each native CMake/Python engine inventory.
engine_contracts.required_result: Original test workflow with --return-code-on-test-failure and test-result --all --verbose plus raw/JUnit inventories.
engine_contracts.limits: Default test exit code may not flag failed assertions; test-result does not replace independently proving package/test discovery. Do not use only packages-select samples for all-official claim.

engine_contracts.required_discovery: Exact nodeids via actual selected interpreter/plugin/config, including deselection, collection errors and import skips.
engine_contracts.required_result: Native collection/execution hook records with nodeid and phase plus XML; reconcile exact nodeids independently of JUnit display names.
engine_contracts.limits: Setup/call/teardown failures, xfail/xpass, skip and interrupted collection remain separate. Test-named executable example can perform work at import without collecting tests.

engine_contracts.required_discovery: Actual built executable and original registered arguments/environment; explicit inner-case inventory when supported by that selected framework.
engine_contracts.required_result: Fresh native XML/case results reconciled against its own discovered universe.
engine_contracts.limits: CTest wrapper count, gtest inner cases, pytest nodeids and XML records are disjoint universes. Disabled/filter/shard/environment selections must be explicit; never sum wrapper and inner cases into coverage.

engine_contracts.required_discovery: Explicit source-bound original programs/models/configuration and complete declared case registry, peers, expected independent witnesses and finite stop conditions.
engine_contracts.required_result: Actual owned process receipts, current namespace/loopback, native mappings, complete observed protocol/state/physics, denied-policy checks, timing/quiet period and cleanup.
engine_contracts.limits: Build demos, print scripts, infinite motor loops, GUI, robot endpoints or GPU tasks are not automatically native JUnit tests. Missing observer/hardware remains a gap.

required_actual_locks: Current complete source/MF and requested upstream project universe metadata SHA.
Resolved immutable repository commit/tree and every submodule/LFS/generated asset source, complete opened-file catalogs.
Actual original workflow/build/test/discovery argv, working directory, environment and option-feature/RMW/OS/architecture matrix.
Actual physical SDK/sysroot/loader/tool/interpreter/compiler/library/header/generator binaries and package/pip/container dependency source hashes.
Every test-definition/config/plugin/executable/fixture/model/expected witness and result parser; no unpinned download during execution.
Current hard64GiB/swap0 owned cgroup, parent process ownership, storage reserve/output deadlines and pidfd/cleanup controls.
Explicit simulator/GPU/display/network/hardware availability disposition; no ambient robot or hardware authority.

unresolved_gaps: 21 distro source/release refs still need actual resolution and complete SDK/source acquisition.
Five historical ROS1 source manifests/SDKs/workflows need authentic recovery.
Per-project options/RMW/platform combinations and actual native package/case inventories are not yet discovered.
Original Unitree build workflows do not themselves contain a complete functional ROS test oracle.
Simulator examples/interactive demos require concrete adapters; unavailable hardware/GPU/native libraries remain gaps.
